# Skills

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs -->

Skills live in `skills/shared/<name>/SKILL.md` (usable by any agent) and `skills/specialized/<name>/SKILL.md` (owned by the agents listed in their frontmatter). The registry discovers them at startup, validates frontmatter, required sections, owners and referenced tools, and agents load full instructions on demand with `magec_skill_load`. Only metadata is placed in an agent's prompt.

Required sections: Purpose, When to use, Inputs, Outputs, Tool requirements, Instructions, Constraints, Validation, Error handling, Related.

## Shared skills

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `checkpoint-management` | Create checkpoints of persistent project state at meaningful stages and use them safely for recovery. |
| `context-management` | Rebuild the working context for a task from the workspace (never from chat history) and keep it small, current and relevant. |
| `dependency-management` | Build and respect dependency-aware task graphs with idempotency keys, scopes and locks so work runs in the right order without duplicates or conflicting writes. |
| `error-handling` | Classify failures correctly, report them honestly with magec_task_fail, and never confuse creative rejection with failure. |
| `figma-context-reading` | Read the connected Figma file through the magec bridge (status, snapshot, reads, reconcile) and understand mappings, ownership and user edits before acting. |
| `progress-reporting` | Report task and project progress accurately from task state, with real evidence and no inflated claims. |
| `project-memory` | Record and respect project decisions, assumptions and rejected directions so work stays consistent across agents and sessions. |
| `quality-standards` | Shared definition of done for ui-ux-magec design work - accessibility, tokens, states, responsive and RTL behaviour, originality and honest verification. |
| `retry-management` | Distinguish retry, redesign, reset and delete, and retry only technical failures within the attempt limit without changing the approach blindly. |
| `source-validation` | Gather and use design references only from permitted, retrieved sources; never fabricate, never bypass access controls, and label verification honestly. |
| `structured-output` | Produce task outputs that validate against the task's output contract on the first try, and report only work that actually happened. |
| `task-communication` | Communicate with other agents and the user through structured, task-attached messages and approvals instead of free-form chat. |
| `tool-selection` | Pick the right magec tool (or host tool) for a step, stay within your permissions, and prefer deterministic tools over reasoning. |
| `user-feedback-processing` | Turn English or Arabic user feedback into correctly scoped intents and tasks, preserving what the user wants kept and never repeating rejected directions. |
| `workspace-access` | Read and write project files in the .ui-ux-magec workspace safely, in the right area, without touching service-owned state. |
